notes: Translated from OVAL's validation file refinement_instead_of_constraint, which OVAL's SHACL validator must reject. Kept: the second permission, whose duty carries the misplaced refinement. Dropped: the first permission, whose payAmount unit is a string, a separate finding (conformance/external/README.md § Triage of what was not translated), and OVAL's example profile IRI, which names no terms. Changed: rules named; Rule and Constraint types added; conflict and profiles declared; the payAmount refinement given the unit IRI of oval-duty-payment; the misplaced refinement's odrl:event lt odrl:policyUsage replaced by an odrl:dateTime bound, because due2 binds no odrl:event. Its place, which is what the case tests, is unchanged. Written as odrl:constraint, the same node would be a condition of the duty (IM §2.6). OVAL keeps no result beyond the rejection.

expected_rejection.why: The duty <http://example.com/policy:88#pay> carries an odrl:refinement of its own, and the ODRL vocabulary places a refinement only on an Action, an AssetCollection, or a PartyCollection (Vocabulary §3.14.3). Normalisation rejects a constraint outside its place in stage 1 (odrl-compound-to-atomic-normalization.md §3), so W1 rejects the policy.

oval_expected.result: invalid: OVAL's SHACL validator must reject it
